doc: The only target-facing input of the I17 Solidity frontend (holon/frontends/solidity), frozen in the I17 preregistration before any extraction ran (BUILD_PLAN 0.1: instruments are inputs). It names what to extract, never what the extraction says: the source unit to compile, the compiler settings, and per edge its kind, its input, the entry function the walker starts from and the selected sink, a keccak256 named by its call stack of source spans from the entry (rule W10 of tests_m2/test_extract_solidity_layout.py). It holds no offset, width, length, field name, condition or revert reason: those come from the compiler's AST and inline-assembly Yul of the pinned checkout. Edge names are the labels the frozen M0 facts use for the same code (enc_sol) or new ones (load_sol), so that the tests can compare.

target.scope: batch header codec, Solidity side: the commit-path header encoder and the header loader
